key_provisions_or_claims: Adds UNECE Regulations Nos 30, 54, 64 and 117 (tyres, TPMS) to the compulsory list in Annex IV of Regulation (EC) 661/2009.
Sets phased application dates from 2012 to 2020 for tyre rolling sound, wet grip and rolling resistance requirements.
Requires tyre pressure monitoring systems on new M1 vehicles; registration of non-compliant vehicles prohibited from 1 Nov 2014.
Clarifies application of UNECE Regulations 13, 13-H, 34 and 55 on braking, fuel tanks and coupling.
Aims to avoid duplication and improve market access through international standards.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Regulation (EU) No 523/2012 amends Regulation (EC) 661/2009 to make certain UNECE regulations on tyres, tyre pressure monitoring, braking, fuel tanks and coupling compulsory for EC vehicle type-approval, with phased implementation dates. It concerns conventional motor vehicle components, not AI.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) No 523/2012 of 20 June 2012 amending Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 as regards the inclusion of certain UNECE Regulations on the type-approval of motor vehicles
